Quelle différence entre DRH externalisé: What is the difference between external and part-time HR management?
L’externalisation désigne une direction: External HR management means an HR function led by an outside professional. Part-time support is a recurring arrangement: a schedule is agreed to support the business leader and managers over time. A one-off engagement can address a defined need.

Sur le terrain : les situations accompag: In practice: situations supported by Borith
La question qui revient le plus souvent: The most frequent question in his discussions with business leaders concerns compliance within their organisation and employment contracts. Borith reviews the consistency between actual duties, collective-agreement classifications and remuneration, as well as the treatment of remote-working allowances. Legal matters are validated with qualified professionals.
Élections CSE dans deux petites entrepri: CSE elections in two small businesses
Dans une entreprise de 14 salariés en Fr: In a French business with 14 employees, Borith organised a partial election for the CSE employee representative body. In another business with fewer than 20 employees, he supported the establishment of its first CSE: communications, the pre-election agreement, correspondence with trade unions and public authorities, and publication of the results. For the second engagement, he also selected and coordinated a postal-voting provider, including tests and support through both rounds.

Pour trois entreprises, dont deux dispos: For three businesses, two of which had entities in Spain, Borith reviewed HR processes and employment contracts, then supported updates to HR policies and the alignment of contracts with collective-agreement requirements. The work also covered mandatory notices, prevention and the selection of specialist providers.
